channel.title: Soodal Games — Dev Log
channel.description: A record of when each game started development at Soodal Games, a solo indie studio run by Choi Hanmin. See the live commit timeline on the site itself.

item.title: Started developing: Stress Smash
item.description: A hit-focused casual game — tap the screen to smash your stress away.

item.title: Started developing: Maze Escape
item.description: A casual maze-escape game where you collect keys to find the way out — one of the earliest titles.

item.title: Started developing: Seat Hunter
item.description: A casual observation game — watch subway passengers and guess who's about to get off.

item.title: Started developing: Color Debt
item.description: A casual puzzle game — merge and pop same-colored faces before your debt grows.

item.title: Started developing: Time Heist 24
item.description: A turn-based strategy game where time itself is your health, your action points, and your score.

item.title: Started developing: Stealth Ops
item.description: A stealth action game with 9 weapon types, 6 mini-games per stage, and a dual-stage map structure.

item.title: Started developing: Mini Court
item.description: A courtroom simulation with 55 cases, Korean/English support, an appeals mode, daily challenges, and a career XP system. Packaged with Electron and also released on Steam.
